subject.title: fix(memory): hide QMD transport metadata from recalled content

question: Must this PR repair or invalidate already persisted QMD-contaminated short-term recalls before closing the canonical bug, or may it land as a forward-only adapter fix with legacy cleanup kept open separately?
rationale: The adapter boundary is technically clear, but safe treatment of mixed backend-agnostic persisted recall state requires an explicit release-scope choice; silently stripping all diff-like records could damage legitimate content, while doing nothing leaves affected users contaminated after upgrade.

options.title: Include one-time cleanup
options.body: Add a doctor-owned migration or safe cache invalidation plus upgrade proof before merging this PR with its current closing claim.

options.title: Land forward-only
options.body: Merge the adapter fix only after removing the closing claim and preserving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106937 as the canonical tracker for legacy recall cleanup.

recommendation.title: Include one-time cleanup
recommendation.body: Add a doctor-owned migration or safe cache invalidation plus upgrade proof before merging this PR with its current closing claim.

likelyOwner.reason: The QMD backend originated in their merged work, making them the strongest available owner for deciding the adapter’s upgrade boundary.
